## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior, data update, or documentation change.

  - [ ] `npm run validate`
  - [ ] `npm run build:pages`
  - [ ] `npm run check:staging`
  - [ ] `npm run test:e2e:smoke`
  - [ ] `npm run test:e2e`
- Browser, device, or accessibility checks:
- Remaining review items:

- [ ] Public files contain no credentials or private paths.
